_about: MISMATCH entries checked by hand against the source and found correct. Read by verify_citations.py --resolved; each is listed in citation_report.md with its reason. Checked 2026-10-02.
singh2020plantdoc: Crossref holds only the short title 'PlantDoc'. The full title 'PlantDoc: A Dataset for Visual Plant Disease Detection' is the one printed in the CoDS-COMAD 2020 proceedings and on arXiv:1911.10317.
koh2020wilds: Cited as the peer-reviewed version: Proceedings of the 38th International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 139, 5637-5664 (2021), checked at proceedings.mlr.press/v139/koh21a.html. The database record is the 2020 arXiv preprint.
gulrajani2020search: Cited as the peer-reviewed version: ICLR 2021 (OpenReview lQdXeXDoWtI; OpenAlex W3039431315 lists the ICLR location). The database record is the 2020 arXiv preprint.
R04716: Crossref deposit reverses the given name and the initials (family 'M.K.S.', given 'Senthilkumar.'). The author is M.K.S. Senthilkumar, as in the publisher's own author string 'Senthilkumar. M.K.S.' (OpenAlex raw name).
R06278: Crossref deposit swaps the Vietnamese family and given names (family 'Minh Triet', given 'Le'). The first author is Le Minh Triet; Le is the family name.
R06739: Crossref deposit swaps the Chinese family and given names (given 'LI', family 'Qiannan') and lists affiliations as authors. The first author is Li Qiannan (Qian-Nan Li in OpenAlex).
